## 47:1 (overlap: 27%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | The-word-of YHWH which came to Jeremiah the-prophet concerning the-Philistines, before Pharaoh struck Gaza. |
| LOGOS | The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines, before Pharaoh struck down Gaza. |
| PNEUMA | This is the LORD's message to Jeremiah about the Philistines, received before Pharaoh's army attacked Gaza. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
